items.title: Parasitic adequate modules form a Serre subcategory and the quotient is quasi-coherent modules
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file adequate.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that the subcategory C of parasitic adequate modules is a Serre subcategory and that the functor v induces an equivalence Adeq(O)/C = QCoh(O_S) (statement lines 2301-2310). The proof identifies C as the kernel of the exact functor v via the characterisation of parasitic adequacy, invokes the standard result that the kernel of an exact functor is a Serre subcategory, obtains the induced exact functor on the quotient from the universal property of the quotient, proves essential surjectivity from the right inverse u of v, and proves faithfulness from the quotient-by-kernel lemma, concluding full faithfulness (proof lines 2312-2330). The level is H3: the quotient functor is constructed and the three properties are each derived from a named input, with the right inverse used twice and labelled as such.
